entities.summary: Mariza Corrêa was a Brazilian anthropologist and sociologist. She was professor at the Department of Anthropology of the State University of Campinas (Unicamp). She was also Unicamp’s Director of the Institute of Philosophy and Human Sciences from 1989 to 1993.

entities.summary: Mariza Corrêa was a Brazilian anthropologist and sociologist. She was professor at the Department of Anthropology of the State University of Campinas (Unicamp). She was also Unicamp’s Director of the Institute of Philosophy and Human Sciences from 1989 to 1993.
